analysis: three comparable spectra from one pooled Jacobian
note: no transport was run for this analysis; it consumes the frozen 32-seed pool only

input.reparameterize_rationale: the pooled artifact already stores J in psi coordinates; pushing it through T again would apply the reparameterization twice

shared_across_all_three_branches.grid: 30 radial bins to 1.5 cm, 4 wavelengths, 120 observables

likelihood_budget.note: the measurement budget enters the likelihood; the 6.4e6 pooled transport photons set the Monte Carlo precision of R and J and never enter it

diagonal_poisson.form: J_w = diag(sqrt(N A / R)) J D

multinomial_fixed_launch.form: J_w = sqrt(N) M^{-1/2} A J D, blockwise per wavelength, M = diag(p) - outer(p, p), p = A R

independent_direct_fisher_forms.poisson: I = N D J^T diag(A / R) J D
independent_direct_fisher_forms.multinomial: I = N D J^T A pinv(M) A J D, summed over wavelength blocks
independent_direct_fisher_forms.purpose: built from the definition rather than from the same J_w, so agreement is evidence and not an algebraic tautology

checks.near_null_read_from: last right singular vector of J_w, not eigh(I)

near_null_coordinates: the right singular vectors of J_w = C^{-1/2} J_psi D live in the scaled coordinate z, where psi = D z, so the psi-space direction is the pushforward D v_z. The field previously named near_null_direction_psi_from_svd held v_z and was mislabelled; it is now near_null_direction_z_from_svd, with near_null_tangent_psi_per_unit_z alongside it. The tangent is stored unnormalized so a unit step along it is a unit displacement in z; a unit-norm copy is kept for display only. Two checks are recorded per branch: J_psi @ (D v_z) equals (J_psi D) @ v_z, and the whitened response along the direction equals the smallest singular value.
